contexts.title: Linux process, resource and network supervision
contexts.problem: Explain an observation of a service worker by identifying the observer, the resource boundary and the process that owns cleanup.

episodes.title: Observe and supervise an isolated Linux service

entering_state.summary: You have traced a namespace view, inspected a cgroup budget and completed a socket lifecycle.

episodes.motivating_limitation: A service supervisor has different process identifiers in two observations. Establish who observed each identifier before you use either to explain resource failures or supervise the worker.

notes.X-T49-002: Match the supervisor across the inner and outer PID views. Reconcile its worker’s pipe report with the fork result, mount marker and cgroup observations.
notes.X-T49-003: Predict the second fork at pids.max values of two and three. Reconcile membership and event deltas with both outcomes.
notes.X-T49-004: Trace each child and pipe end through normal exit, failed startup, and a worker that outlives the first shutdown request.
notes.X-T49-005: Compare two binds to the same loopback address within one network namespace with one bind in each of two namespaces.

exiting_artifact.description: A service supervision record linking each observation to its namespace, resource budget, owned worker or socket.
exiting_artifact.competence: A service supervision record linking each observation to its namespace, resource budget, owned worker or socket.

episodes.transition_reason: The required sequence ends with the network observation. The elective service diagnosis brings the four investigations together.

episodes.title: Elective investigation of a slow telemetry service

entering_state.summary: You can identify the observed process, trace a resource refusal, account for child cleanup and interpret a socket bind in its network namespace.

episodes.motivating_limitation: The service starts but responds slowly. Establish which observations can distinguish the competing explanations.

notes.X-T49-006: Keep the request batch fixed. Compare cgroup CPU counters, write refusals and payload conservation across baseline, quota and stalled-consumer trials.

exiting_artifact.description: An evidence-backed diagnosis with the original observation, comparison and remaining uncertainty.
exiting_artifact.competence: An evidence-backed diagnosis with the original observation, comparison and remaining uncertainty.

episodes.transition_reason: Course completion uses the four required investigations. This elective records a separate opportunity for transfer.
